answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can transact, and release it only after a slow, verifiable work history. Like a river that only runs clear after passing through an umber filter bed, the network checks each agent's pulse of signed actions over time: identities with no history earn no trust and no payout. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity and wait out the same aging period, so each copy costs real capital and time while producing nothing until it matures, making mass fakery unprofitable.
